mapper.select: SELECT j.*, c.name AS company_name, c.logo AS company_logo, c.industry AS company_industry, c.scale AS company_scale FROM job j LEFT JOIN company c ON j.company_id = c.id WHERE j.deleted = 0 AND j.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY j.hot_score DESC, j.apply_count DESC, j.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
